title: THE HOWLER WALKS ON ITS OWN STEP
why: His yes on pick 73, motion only. The sentry, warden (so the Overseer) and bulwark have the heavy clank, the crawler a skitter, the Crier a drone, and the pillbox and Listener do not walk. The Howler walks and was the only machine on the light pillager scuff, so it gets a short pneumatic tick of its own: a click, a knock around 1.5 kHz, a falling triangle and a faint hiss, at most one per 150 ms and no held tone. The other machines are unchanged.
now: The Howler now has its own walking sound, a quick pneumatic tick. The other machines sound as before.
